problems: The blind guess ('bird in flight with a raised, spread wing') only partly fits. The raised right wing is legible, but the body reads as a vertical stick with a tail hanging below, not as a raven. The shape is closer to a standing figure or a kite than to a corvid in flight.

The blue silhouette does not form a coherent bird. The left-hand loop (around x 235-265, y 240-355) is a stray contour rather than a wing or body, and the head is a small hook at the top with no beak or neck.

Star placement is roughly right: 54951 head (270,217), 54872 breast (276,280), 54879 tail (275,403), 53417 elbow (378,177), 52457 outer wingtip (447,212), 53954 trailing feathers (342,288). But the wing is a thin lozenge made of gold lines, so the stars sit on a skeleton rather than on a drawn form.
The wing triangle ends at 53954 and does not really connect to the body, so the trailing feathers look detached.

Labels collide and truncate: 'the raven's head, at the eye' overlaps the outline, 'the breast, the heart of the' runs into 'the trailing wing feathers w', and 'the elbow of the raised righ' and 'lifted to' are cut off.
The unlabeled star at (84,282) is far off the figure and reads as a stray point, not part of the raven.
output.advice: Redraw as a single closed silhouette, not a gold skeleton with a loose blue outline. (1) Rotate the bird so the body runs roughly horizontal or diagonal, head to the upper-left, tail to the lower-right, since a raven in flight is not a vertical stick. (2) Head: a small rounded knob with a short beak, centred on 54951 at (270,217), with the eye at that star. (3) Body: a plump teardrop from the head down through 54872 at (276,280), widest at the breast, tapering to the tail. (4) Tail: a forked end at 54879 (275,403), with two prongs spread from that star. (5) Raised right wing: a broad leading edge from the shoulder near the body up to the elbow 53417 (378,177), then out to the outer tip 52457 (447,212), and back along a trailing edge through 53954 (342,288) so the feathers join the body cleanly. (6) Delete the stray left loop, and drop the stray star at (84,282) or mark it as background. (7) Move labels to clear space (e.g. left margin or leader lines) and shorten them so none overlap or truncate.
